import random
import sys


def main():
    seed = int(sys.stdin.read().split()[0])
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = rng.randint(1, 5)
    m = rng.randint(1, 5)
    print(n, m)
    for _ in range(n):
        print(''.join('#' if rng.random() < 0.3 else '.' for _ in range(m)))


main()
